label: Baseline
hypothesis: Freeze the original thresholded writer and recency-based retrieval.
predicted_effect: Useful direct facts work; entity and temporal ambiguity remain visible.

proposer.name: Codex
proposer.attribution: Authored by Codex while building this demo, with public access to all scenarios; no runtime provider call.

label: Agent proposal 1
hypothesis: Enabling entity filtering and time-aware retrieval will select the requested subject and validity interval before ranking, correcting entity distractor and historical/future-date failures without changing writes or hard-constraint behavior.
predicted_effect: Task success should improve on entity-grounding, distractor-retrieval, historical-address, future-move, and related temporal cases; retrieval should contain fewer irrelevant records and reduce stale-fact errors.

label: Agent proposal 2
hypothesis: Enabling deduplication will reuse identical active values confirmed at later effective dates, reducing redundant storage without changing retrieval correctness.
predicted_effect: Task success and hard-constraint results should remain unchanged on these public cases, while storage records and bytes should decrease for repeated identical confirmations.

label: Agent proposal 3
hypothesis: Lowering min_confidence from 0.7 to 0.6 will admit the useful borderline-confidence fact while continuing to reject the lower-confidence unnecessary and conflicting writes shown in the evidence.
predicted_effect: Complete-scenario task success should improve by recovering the Portuguese answer, with no expected change to the demonstrated hard constraints or duplicate-storage behavior.
